allowedProviders.title: Allowed AI providers
allowedProviders.description: Subset of: claude, nano, heuristic. Providers not listed are turned off and locked.

excludedHosts.title: Domains excluded from remote AI
excludedHosts.description: Added to the user's own list. Subdomains included. Never sent to a remote model.

forbidPathSending.title: Forbid sending URL paths
forbidPathSending.description: If true, only the title and the domain are sent.

disableAutoGroup.title: Disable automatic grouping
disableAutoGroup.description: If true, grouping is manual only.

allowUserApiKey.title: Allow a personal API key (BYOK)
allowUserApiKey.description: If false, the user cannot use their own Anthropic key.

apiKeyStorage.title: Storage of the personal API key
apiKeyStorage.description: session = memory only (cleared when Chrome closes); local = persistent.

allowedModels.title: Allowed models
allowedModels.description: Allowlist of model ids; the first one is the default.

allowDesktopBridge.title: Allow the Claude Desktop bridge
allowDesktopBridge.description: If false, the extension does not expose tabs to Claude Desktop through MCP.

proxyEndpoint.title: Corporate proxy endpoint
proxyEndpoint.description: HTTPS URL compatible with the Messages API. The credential lives in the proxy's vault; the extension sends no API key.
